products.name: Espresso
products.description: Kuchli, quyuq va biroz achchiq. Kichik finjonda beriladi; shirinlik sifatida brownie bilan yaxshi mos keladi. Menyudagi tavsiya: kunduzgi payt.

products.name: Cappuccino
products.description: Espresso, sut va mayin ko‘pik uyg‘unligi; yumshoq va muvozanatli. Ertalab yoki kunduzgi tanaffusda, kruassan bilan mos.

products.name: Latte
products.description: Sutli, mayin va espresso ta’mi yengilroq seziladi. Ertalab yoki tushdan keyin; cheesecake bilan yaxshi juftlik.

products.name: Americano
products.description: Qora qahvaga o‘xshash, yengilroq tana va aniq qahva ta’mi. Kunduzgi payt ichimligi; shokoladli tort bilan mos.

products.name: Mocha
products.description: Qahva va shokolad aralashmasi, shirin va qaymoqsimon. Kunduzgi desert tanaffusida tiramisu bilan mos.

products.name: Caramel Macchiato
products.description: Sutli espresso, vanil va karamelning shirin notalari. Kunduzgi payt; dolchinli bulochka bilan mazali uyg‘unlik.

products.name: Vanilla Latte
products.description: Mayin sutli latte va vanilning yoqimli hidi. Kunduzgi payt; makaron shirinliklari bilan mos.

products.name: Iced Coffee
products.description: Sovuq, tetiklantiruvchi va qahva ta’mi aniq. Issiq kunlarda kunduzgi payt; shokoladli muffin bilan mos.

products.name: Cold Brew
products.description: Sovuq usulda damlangan, odatda yumshoqroq va nordonligi pastroq. Kunduzgi payt; mevali tart bilan mos.

products.name: Raf Coffee
products.description: Qaymoqli, yumshoq va vanilga o‘xshash shirin hidli. Kunduzgi desert paytida Red Velvet bilan mos.

products.name: Turkish Coffee
products.description: Quyuq, kuchli va o‘ziga xos. An’anaviy usulda tayyorlanadi. Kichik finjonda beriladi; lokum yoki shokolad bilan mos.

products.name: Matcha Latte
products.description: Mayin, sutli va o‘ziga xos yashil choy ta’miga ega. Sovuq yoki issiq holda tayyorlanadi. Kunduzgi payt ichish uchun mos.

products.name: Chocolate Cake
products.description: Boy shokoladli, nam va yumshoq. Americano yoki shakarsiz latte bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Cheesecake
products.description: Qaymoqsimon, mayin va yengil nordon. Latte yoki cappuccino bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Brownie
products.description: Zich, yumshoq va kuchli shokoladli. Espresso yoki Americano bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Tiramisu
products.description: Qahva, kakao va mascarpone kremi uyg‘unligi. Mocha yoki cappuccino bilan mos.

products.name: Strawberry Tart
products.description: Qulupnayning mevali nordon-shirinligi va qarsildoq asos. Cold Brew bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Croissant
products.description: Sariyog‘li, yengil va qat-qat qarsildoq. Cappuccino yoki latte bilan nonushta paytida mos.

products.name: Cinnamon Roll
products.description: Dolchinli, yumshoq va usti shirin glazurli. Caramel Macchiato bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Macarons
products.description: Tashqi qismi yengil qarsildoq, ichi yumshoq va shirin. Vanilla Latte bilan mos.

products.name: Chocolate Muffin
products.description: Yumshoq, mayin va shokolad bo‘lakchali. Iced Coffee bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Red Velvet Cake
products.description: Mayin kakao notasi va qaymoqli krem. Raf Coffee bilan yaxshi mos.

products.name: Lemon Cake
products.description: Limonning yengil nordonligi, yumshoq xamir va shirin glazur uyg‘unligi. Americano bilan yaxshi mos keladi.

products.name: Strawberry Cheesecake
products.description: Qaymoqli pishloq kremi, yumshoq asos va qulupnayning shirin-nordon ta’mi. Latte bilan juda yaxshi mos keladi.
